title: clusia scandens
intro: Clusia scandens, commonly known as the "Monkey Cup" or "Clusia Tree", is a species of flowering plant in the Clusiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Clusia scandens include its ability to relax the muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
